about: ADR 0022 §5.7 ownership vectors shared with complyd-pipeline-action (copy this file; both sides test against it). Globs are as the config writes them; both sides collapse consecutive ** parts first. owner: the system the file belongs to; null with tie: true = a tie between systems (the action: config error; the server: the file is claimed by neither). A bare ** is left out here: the server reads it as the repository's default AI paths only.

cases.name: the more literal glob wins over a longer one
a literal prefix beats many single stars
a nested folder beats its parent
equal literal characters across systems: a tie
the same glob in two systems: a tie
? counts as a wildcard, not a literal
